_how_to_use: Fill every field, delete unused ones, pass JSON.stringify(this) as the prompt to fal/flux-2-pro with refs. Refs are 'image 1', 'image 2'. No negative prompts on FLUX.2 (checked 2026-10).
scene: Claudia between takes in a white studio

subjects.description: Claudia from image 1: 28-year-old adult woman, glossy jet-black jaw-length blunt bob, heavy straight bangs, one peach-orange streak panel through the front bangs on one side, the rest jet-black, small peach star hair clip, a thin headset mic, light freckles, grey-green eyes
subjects.wardrobe: a floor-length cloud-print halter gown with a mint satin halter band, an orange shield visor
subjects.position: centre, three-quarter to camera, one hand behind her back
subjects.action: lifting the orange visor up into her bangs with one hand, looking into the lens

background: seamless pale grey-white studio paper, the gown's train spread on the floor
lighting: soft daylight from camera left, a long soft floor shadow
composition: medium shot from the waist up, rule of thirds, her face in the upper third
camera: Fujifilm X-T5, 50mm f/2.8, eye level, shallow depth of field, focus on her eyes
style: photoreal editorial, clean colour, fine grain, natural skin texture with visible pores, no text, no logos
